headline: Executive order creates a White House initiative focused on education and economic opportunity for Black Americans.
what_it_does: This order sets up a White House Initiative aimed at improving educational equity, excellence, and economic opportunity for Black Americans. Based on the title alone, the specific programs, offices, funding, or duties it creates are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The initiative is directed at advancing educational and economic opportunity for Black Americans.
Agencies would likely take part in carrying out the initiative, though the title does not say how.
